mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BUILDING_SCHEDULE ( BSC_ID, BLDG_ID, BSC_TITL_NM, BSC_CONT, BSC_STR_DTM, BSC_END_DTM, BSC_RPT_SET_CONT, RENTAL_PTY_ID, BSC_DEL_YN ) VALUES ( #{bscId}, #{bldgId}, #{bscTitlNm}, #{bscCont}, #{bscStrDtm}, #{bscEndDtm}, #{bscRptSetCont}, #{rentalPtyId}, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE BUILDING_SCHEDULE SET BSC_TITL_NM = #{bscTitlNm}, BSC_CONT = #{bscCont}, BSC_STR_DTM = #{bscStrDtm}, BSC_END_DTM = #{bscEndDtm}, BSC_RPT_SET_CONT = #{bscRptSetCont} WHERE BSC_ID = #{bscId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM BUILDING_SCHEDULE WHERE BSC_ID = #{bscId} AND BSC_DEL_YN ='N'
